purpose: Handbook page about the repeat bin (Herhalen).
details: Explains the Leitner system per topic: wrong answers come back on later days as similar questions with new numbers; a table lists what happens after right and wrong repeats and when an item counts as mastered.
summary: Explains Herhalen: mistakes return in following days as similar questions, handled with a Leitner box system per topic (e.g. 'km to m', 'tafel 7'); a table shows what happens after right or wrong repeats and mastery gives bonus points.
